exceptions.reason: SQLx SQLite-only production tree excludes the optional MySQL/RSA dependency. Lockfile presence is not executable reachability.
exceptions.followUp: Keep SQLx default features disabled; re-evaluate before enabling MySQL, PostgreSQL or another release target.

exceptions.reason: Application ZIP readers manually validate and copy entries; they never call ZipArchive/ZipStreamReader extraction. Links, privileged file types, unsafe paths and collisions are rejected. Updater legacy ZIP support is disabled. ZIP 9 failed the CP437 asset-name regression, so upgrading now would corrupt legitimate mod references.
exceptions.evidence: https://rustsec.org/advisories/RUSTSEC-2026-0367.html; security/README.md; CI windows-tree.txt; src-tauri/src/modules/library/application/mods/archive/zip_reader.rs; archive regression tests
exceptions.followUp: Adopt an upstream version that fixes the extraction advisories AND preserves flag-aware CP437 names; keep the archive regression suite and re-review the whole Rust source tree after any source change.
